title: Parameter sets
description: A collection of parameter sets for one function, e.g. the 28 Hazus bridge classes for one fragility function, or for one model a function uses (e.g. the spatial correlation of a hazard field). Each set's `values` must satisfy that function's or model's `instance_schema`; a few sets serve many rows, which is how a handful of curves describes every bridge.

model.description: A model under schema/models/, for sets that parameterise part of a function rather than a function (e.g. spatial-correlation).

source.description: Provenance shared by every set in this file: citation, table, retrieval, verification.
Provenance specific to this set, overriding the file's.

region.description: Where this set applies, for a binding that chooses by location: the first listed set whose polygon contains a row's lat/lon.

polygon.description: [lon, lat] vertices in degrees; the ring closes itself.

basis.description: Where the boundary comes from, e.g. the model's stated range, or an assumption.
